abstract: Gene implication methods (GIMs) are essential tools for identifying potential causal genes from GWAS signals, but considerable inter-method variability complicates follow-up studies. We present the LocusCompare2 platform to incorporate six popular GIMs and hundreds of QTL datasets, enabling validation across multiple GIMs and window settings to improve accuracy and reproducibility.
